title: Sweeteners
hook: The US Department of Agriculture’s Sugar and Sweeteners Yearbook Tables provide “summary statistics on sugar, sugarbeets, sugarcane, corn sweeteners (dextrose, glucose, and high-fructose corn syrup), and honey.” Compiled by the agency’s Economic Research Service from a range of national, international, and industry sources, the statistics are provided as regularly-updated spreadsheets, many of which go back multiple decades.
